faq.label: HELP CENTER
faq.title: Frequently asked questions.
faq.subtitle: Answers about our planned features and initial rollout.

sections.title: Can I use my own domain?
sections.description: Yes. Authorized company administrators will verify sending domains through DNS.

sections.title: Can I create my own templates?
sections.description: Create company templates and save reusable designs in the template studio.

sections.title: Can I customize my email footer?
sections.description: Yes. Company branding, links and reusable footer templates are core features.

sections.title: Can I send WhatsApp messages?
sections.description: WhatsApp is planned for a future release.

sections.title: Can I pay to upgrade?
sections.description: Approved workspaces can use Paystack checkout after payment configuration. Live payment acceptance must be verified before launch.

sections.title: Is the platform ready for live use?
sections.description: Core features are implemented in source. Production security and integration acceptance are still required before launch.
